_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Katrineholm C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). NEEDS THE DRAFT SCRIPT'S walk_cycleways OPTION: the only way under the tracks, Lövatunneln, is a cycleway with foot=designated, which the script otherwise skips. Two floors: street, station and platforms (0) and Lövatunneln (-1, from its layer). Platform 1 is beside the station building, 3/4 is an island and 5 is on the south side by bus stop D. Checked against Sörmlandstrafiken's Katrineholm resecentrum map (2025-02-25) supplied by the owner: tracks 1, 3, 4, 5, the tunnel, its covered stairs up to the island and to platform 5 (in OSM) and three lifts. OSM has none of the lifts; the island's and platform 5's are added from the map's symbols (about ±5 m). The map's third lift, at the tunnel's north end by platform 1, isn't added: its symbol sits 13 m from the tunnel and it isn't clear where it comes down; the cycle ramp beside it already gives a step-free way up to platform 1 and Stationsplan.

connections.note: Lövatunneln's north end: OSM's tunnel (way 444809214) meets the cycleway up to Stationsplan (way 106547371) at one node, which the draft splits into its two levels. A cycle path, so a ramp with no steps.
Lift to the 3/4 island: on Sörmlandstrafiken's plan (2025-02-25), not in OSM. Placed from the plan's symbol, 7 m east of the tunnel, about ±5 m.
Lift to platform 5 and bus stop D: on the plan, not in OSM; placed the same way.

South of the tracks the tunnel runs on in an open cut (way 444809215, layer -1 but not a tunnel) to the Fabriksgatan tunnel; the draft reads the cut as street level, so its ends are joined by hand (flat, no steps).
Same, at the cut's south end, into the tunnel under Fabriksgatan (way 444809213).

sources.title: Sörmlandstrafiken, Katrineholm resecentrum (map version 2025-02-25)
sources.note: Supplied by the owner; used to check tracks, the tunnel and stairs, to place two lifts and the waiting room (fitted to OSM's tunnel and tracks; about ±5 m). Its base map is OpenStreetMap; the symbols are Sörmlandstrafiken's. Not ODbL; see data/stations/README.md.

Jernhusen: toilet and accessible toilet, card payment (matches OSM). Its shop list names only Katrineholm Turistinformation (Stationsplan 4, Mon–Fri 11–15), which no source places, so it isn't on the map.
Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000166).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract, foot-designated cycleways included), checked against Sörmlandstrafiken's map (2025-02-25): tunnel ends joined by hand, lifts to the 3/4 island and platform 5 and the waiting room added from the map, Pressbyrån (OSM, the map's kiosk) added.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 5 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000166).
